text:
Hector: RetailCloud (SI partner) asked us for a marketplace + private deployment reference architecture. Deliverables: 1) Terraform module (hub/spoke + marketplace packaging), 2) refarch diagram + 1-page ops runbook, 3) minimal sample app + smoke CI. Timeline: 2 weeks. Who can take ownership?
Lin: I can own the Terraform module. Plan a single module with `deploy_mode = "marketplace" | "private"` and a `hardware_profile` var. Will include examples for VPC peering and a marketplace-optimized NLB.
Lin: example snippet: ```terraform
module "retailcloud_marketplace" {
  source      = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-stencils/retailcloud"
  deploy_mode = var.deploy_mode # marketplace | private
  regions     = var.regions
  hardware_profile = var.hardware_profile # ampere | h100
}
```
Jasper: I'll draft the README and packaging checklist. Need partner-signed manifest, SBOM, and a short "how to verify image signature" section. Also include a short perf blurb (non-prod lab numbers) for the listing.
Marisol: Ops/CI note  I'll add `ci/marketplace-smoke.yml` that builds SBOM, runs a smoke deploy (ephemeral acct), executes `scripts/verify_deploy.sh --mode ${{ inputs.deploy_mode }}`, then tears down. I'll stub the workflow and basic verify script.
Lin: Good call. I'll emit module outputs: `service_endpoint`, `deployed_image`, and `smoke_report_url` so CI can pick them up.
Hector: RetailCloud confirmed they will provide signed OCI images and a weekly CVE report and asked for a multi-AZ example. Also asked we include a minimal client (curl + python) for the sample app.
Jasper: I'll add `examples/minimal-client` and a short prompt set (5 prompts) for sanity/latency checks.
partner-onboard-bot: Created ticket P-4302: "RetailCloud marketplace + private refarch module" assigned to @Lin and linked to partner-onboarding epic.
Marisol: I'll open the GH action PR with the smoke job by Tue. Can we do a sync Thurs 10am PT to review module + CI?
Hector: Works for me. Thanks team :thumbsup:
